Joining a growing finance team, the Accounts Assistant will report directly to the Senior Accountant and support the day-to-day running of the finance function. - Maintaining accurate financial records and supporting audit preparation
- Identifying and supporting improvements to financial processes and systems
- Providing general finance administrative support to the wider team

- At least 6 months' experience in an accounts or administrative role
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
- Experience using accounting software such as Sage would be an advantage
- Organised, accurate and able to manage multiple tasks to deadlines
- Strong communicator who can work well within a collaborative team environment
- A genuine interest in developing a career in finance
- AAT studier or open to undertaking qualifications

What is on offer alongside the Accounts Assistant position:
- £28,000 - £29,000 base salary depending on experience
- Quarterly performance - shared bonus scheme based on percentage of total income
- Unlimited holiday, genuinely one of the best benefits at this level
- Flexible working - informal hybrid arrangement with 1 day per week from home
- Pension - 3% employer contribution via salary sacrifice
- Laptop and mobile phone provided
- Bar at the office and rooftop terrace, a culture that takes the social side seriously
- AAT study support available
- Access to staff discount and savings platform

How to apply for the Accounts Assistant position:

If this sounds like the right next step for you, apply today. Alternatively, contact Martin Richardson at Sellick Partnership for a confidential conversation about the role.

Proven experience in a Credit Control role, with a track record of successfully reducing debtor days and managing a high-volume ledger.

Strong communication skills - you are confident on the telephone and in writing, and can handle difficult conversations professionally and calmly.

Highly organised, with the ability to prioritise a busy workload and meet deadlines consistently.

Proficient in accounting software and Microsoft Excel.

A team player who is also capable of working independently and using their own initiative.
